description: Move the specified record IDs to trash in the selected Vault. Requires delete permission. Use it for records that are wrong, repeated or no longer true, and for records the user asks to remove. Records can be restored for 30 days. Returns the number moved; it does not delete or select a Vault. Permanent deletion is available only in the dashboard.

ids.description: Record IDs to move to trash.
